program.name: Arnold Split
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: The classic bodybuilding split at home: chest and back together, shoulders and arms, then legs.
program.about: The classic bodybuilding split, adapted for dumbbells, a kettlebell and a bar. Chest and back share a day, shoulders and arms get the next, and legs the third, all in straight sets with abs to finish. Floor flys, Arnold presses and Bulgarian split squats join the familiar moves. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps. For building muscle more than chasing numbers.
